content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "This is the real reason, not a resume line. Ten years of making other people's operations work, and the thing that actually got you here is your grandfather getting squeezed on what he grew.

That's a sharper starting point than "food supply chains" as a category. It's closer to: who's on the wrong end of that math right now, farmers like him or somewhere else in the chain."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
